title: Virtual transcript and render cache
objective: Move Swarm's conversation transcript onto virtualized message rendering with stable message keys, measured row heights, and append-only render caching for long sessions.
actions: Introduce a virtual conversation list that renders only the visible transcript range plus overscan.
Cache rendered markdown lines by stable message identity and terminal column width.
Invalidate cached heights and wrapped lines when terminal width changes.
Keep append-only updates O(delta) for streaming sessions and fall back to full rebuild on clear/resume/compaction.
Preserve existing line-windowing behavior as a fallback for non-fullscreen or disabled-virtualization mode.

criteria: Long transcripts do not mount every message row in fullscreen mode.
Appending one assistant/tool/progress message does not recompute the full transcript.
Terminal resize invalidates width-sensitive cached wrapping safely.
Existing conversation layout and render tests continue to pass.
A dedicated long-session test covers at least 1000 rendered messages without full tree mounting.

non_goals: Do not change message semantics or transcript event mapping beyond what virtualization requires.
Do not remove the existing non-virtual fallback path.
Do not optimize unrelated runtime stores in this task.
findings: ConversationFirstPane now renders through VirtualConversationList with message-level render caching by object identity and terminal width. Long-session tests cover 1000 messages, visible-only mounting, append-only cache reuse, and width-sensitive invalidation.
